name: pyret-embed
description: A library for embedding Pyret into webpages

scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run types && cd ../code.pyret.org && make link-pyret && npm run build && cd ../embed && npm run copy-pyret
scripts.build:ts: npm run build:full && cd ../code.pyret.org && make web-ts && cd ../embed && npm run copy-pyret
